title: A 2-Year Study Exploring Whether Pegcetacoplan Can Safely Prevent C3 Glomerulopathy or Primary Immune Complex–Mediated MPGN From Returning After Kidney Transplantation
official: A 2-year, single-arm, multi-center study to explore the efficacy and safety of pegcetacoplan in preventing disease recurrence in adolescent and adult kidney transplant recipients with C3 glomerulopathy or primary immune-complex membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis
summary: Main objective: To explore the efficacy of pegcetacoplan in preventing clinically significant recurrence of C3G or primary IC-MPGN after kidney transplantation
conditions: Male or female patients with a diagnosis of C3G or primary IC˗MPGN and planning to undergo kidney transplantation because of the disease.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Male or female patients with a diagnosis of C3G or primary IC-MPGN and planning to undergo kidney transplantation because of the disease
2. Age 12 years or older at the time of providing confirmatory informed consent / assent.
3. Have a high risk of disease recurrence after kidney transplantation, based on either having a previous kidney allograft loss due to recurrence of C3G or primary IC-MPGN, or as assessed as having a high risk by the Investigator based on other clinical information.
4. Is fully vaccinated and up to date with their vaccinations against Streptococcus pneumoniae, Neisseria meningitidis, and Haemophilus influenzae B, as per local guidelines, at the time of initiating pegcetacoplan.
Exclusion criteria:
1. A known secondary cause for MPGN, including but not limited to monoclonal gammopathy of clinical significance, hepatitis B, hepatitis C, or autoimmune cryoglobulinemia
2. Use of a complement inhibitor for the treatment of C3G or primary IC-MPGN within 1 month prior to the scheduled kidney transplantation surgery
